svg.title: NFE vs real-time factor comparison
svg.desc: Comparison of the original RTX 3090 run and x-vector RTX 4090 run for rtf. Each dot is a prompt result; lines are medians and whiskers are IQR.
svg.text: Full 54-prompt sweep: NFE vs real-time factor comparison
Matched prompt IDs and NFE settings. GPU labels follow run-owner information; JSON records CUDA.
RTF = latency / WAV duration. Values below 1 are faster than playback.
54 matched prompts • 486 measured generations per run • one result per prompt/NFE • warmups excluded
Same NFE values, prompt snapshots, seed, solver, precision, and guidance. Only the x-vector run records voice conditioning.
Run-to-run comparison. The baseline conditioning is unspecified, so this does not isolate the x-vector effect.
